newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aboitiz, Metro down on water deal.
newsitem.headline: Aboitiz, Metro down on water deal.

text.p: Aboitiz Equity Ventures and Metro Pacific Corp dropped in mid-session trading on Friday, a day after they lost out on bidding for the privatisation of the Metropolitan Water and Sewerage System (MWSS), brokers said.
Aboitiz shed 40 centavos, or 12.50 percent, to 2.80 pesos while Metro Pacific lost 40 centavos, or 5.56 percent to 6.80 pesos.
"These two companies were not among the winning bidders, hence, we see some selling," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Securities Inc.
Aboitiz submitted a bid for the MWSS concession in a joint venture with Compagnie Generale des Eaux, House of Investments and Dharmala Phils Inc.
Metro Pacific, on the other hand, joined forces with Anglian Water Plc and the Australia Water Technologies Pty Ld.
Two consortiums, which included Ayala Corp and Benpres Holdings Corp, were proclaimed as the winners of the 25-year MWSS contracts on Thursday.
House of Investments also lost in mid-morning trade, falling 15 centavos, or 4.41 percent, to 3.25 pesos, but trade in the counter was thin at 26,000 shares.
A total of 7.285 million Aboitiz shares and 1.336 million Metro Pacific shares changed hands by 0250 GMT.
